bio_am: Ծնած է Ղարաբաղի Խաչէն գաւառի Ղշլաղ գիւղը՝ 1867-ին։ Խանասորի արշաւանքի իսկական կազմակերպիչը, մահացած է 1914-ին։
bio_en: Nikol Ter-Hovhannisian, known as Nikol Duman, was born in 1867 in the village of Ghshlagh (Tsaghkashat) in the Khachen district of Karabakh, the son of a priest, and finished the Shushi diocesan school in 1887. After teaching in the North Caucasus he moved to Tabriz in 1891 and in 1893 to Ghalasar in Salmast, where he won fame as teacher, revolutionary and fighter; in 1894 he was wounded while mediating a quarrel among Armenakans, and in October 1895 he led a band through snow into Van via Saray and Boghazkesan. Considered the true architect of the Khanasor expedition of July 1897, in which he served as an officer, he was regarded by Ruben as the oldest intellectual fedayi of the ARF and an authority obeyed by Hrayr, Gevorg Chavush and Andranik alike; Dro, who called him his great teacher, served under him in 1905-06. He died in 1914, mourned in the Tiflis press in September of that year.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Death: obituary in Horizon 28 Sept 1914 (#10); #676 places the anniversary in late October. Manner of death not described in the texts read.
